verdict.rationale: Zep documents an official Python SDK (`pip install zep-cloud`). A method-by-method v3-to-v4 migration map covers Python, TypeScript, and Go, and the SDK Reference pages carry per-language code samples, which implies the same memory API surface across languages. missing for 10: explicit TypeScript SDK install/quick-start evidence, an explicit statement of API parity between the Python and TypeScript SDKs, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can build against official SDKs in at least Python and TypeScript with equivalent memory APIs

citations.quote: A method-by-method map from the Zep v3 SDK to v4, plus the behavior changes that need more than a rename", covering Python, TypeScript, and Go.
